Delhi High Court denies plea to move activist Sonam Wangchuk to private hospital

The Delhi High Court has rejected a plea seeking to transfer activist Sonam Wangchuk from a government facility to a private hospital. Wangchuk, who has been on a hunger strike, had his wife state that he would end his fast if the House took up his cause. The court's decision means he will remain in the government facility.
